definition: A proposed alignment technique in which two AI systems argue opposing sides of a question in front of a human or AI judge, aiming to surface truthful information more reliably than a single model's unchallenged output.
details: AI debate is explored as a potential scalable oversight mechanism, on the theory that it may be easier to judge which side of a well-structured debate is correct than to independently verify a complex claim from scratch.
story: Picture guardrails on a mountain road — not there to slow you down on the straightaways, but to keep you from flying off the cliff. Think of it this way: A proposed alignment technique in which two AI systems argue opposing sides of a question in front of a human or AI judge, aiming to surface truthful information more reliably than a single model's unchallenged output. And here is the clever part: AI debate is explored as a potential scalable oversight mechanism, on the theory that it may be easier to judge which side of a well-structured debate is correct than to independently verify a complex claim from scratch. It is the difference between “it works” and “it is safe to put in front of people.” And that is Debate (AI Safety technique) — the reason we can move fast without breaking things, or people.
